commands: echo "RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-none} ATTEMPT=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-none}"; mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1997/run-current; gh pr diff 1997 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1997/run-current/diff.patch | grep -c '^diff --git'

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow 2>/dev/null; echo "===== ruff.toml ====="; git show d201f900:ruff.toml; echo; echo "===== ci.yml ruff pins (head) ====="; grep -n 'ruff==' .github/workflows/ci.yml .github/workflows/devflow-implement.yml

for f in exec-with-default-signals signal_launcher launch-detached; do echo "===== $f ====="; awk -v pat="lib/test/$f.py" '$0 ~ "^diff --git a/lib/test/"f".py" {found=1} found&&/^diff --git/&&$0!~"lib/test/"f".py"{found=0} found' f="$f" .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1997/run-current/diff.patch 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[+-]' | grep -iE 'lambda|preexec|def ' | head; done

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow; for f in lib/test/assertion-floor-retention-check.py lib/generate-plugin-identity.py lib/migrate-config-values.py scripts/branch-for-issue.py scripts/discover-deferral-manifests.py scripts/inventory-workflow-transcripts.py scripts/stall-observer-scan.py; do printf '%s: ' "$f"; git show d201f900:"$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'from __future__ import annotations' && echo HAS || echo MISSING; done

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow; for f in lib/test/assertion-floor-retention-check.py lib/generate-plugin-identity.py lib/migrate-config-values.py scripts/branch-for-issue.py scripts/discover-deferral-manifests.py scripts/inventory-workflow-transcripts.py scripts/stall-observer-scan.py scripts/reception_identity.py scripts/section_parse.py scripts/workflow_flight_recorder.py; do r=$(git show "d201f900:$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'from __future__ import annotations'); echo "$f: $r"; done

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
